decision_rationale: This is a new post-training method for LLMs, not a review, benchmark, or wrapper. The evidence includes biomedical text/instructions and biologically grounded reasoning/generation tasks, supporting both a text component and a substantive text-bio bridge.
evidence_snippet: "biomedical text"; "clinical instruction and a set of rubrics"; "replace the GPT-4o backbone in GeneAgent"; "professional biomedical profile texts"
